d:
World no.5 Nodirbek Abdusattorov is back in action at Budapest for the Total Chess World Championship Tour Pilot. Right before the Blitz tournament, we did a detailed interview with Nodirbek - he talks about this format, the training camp with Magnus Carlsen, getting engaged with Sevinch Mavlanova, and his new second Temur Kuybokarov.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Himank Ghosh
